The '''1934-35 Serie A''' was the thirty-fifth edition of the [[Italian Football Championship]] and its sixth season since [[1929–30 Serie A|1929]] re-[[brand]]ing to create [[Serie A]]. It was the twelfth season from which the Italian Football Champions adorned their team jerseys in the subsequent season with a [[Scudetto]]. [[Juventus]] were champions for the last of five successive season and for the seventh time in their [[history]]. This was their sixth scudetto since the scudetto started being awarded in [[1923–24 Prima Divisione|1924]] and their fifth win contested as Serie A.
[[Image:Serie A (football) 1934-35.png|thumb|325px|right|Serie A 1934-35 teams distribution]]

==Teams==
[[Sampierdarenese]] had been promoted from [[Serie B]].
